A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 5-day concomitant H. pylori eradication therapy with amoxicillin and clarithromycin is effective and can be considered for routine use in Thailand.
the 7-day triple therapy is still a standard treatment for H. pylori eradication in Thailand, while the 10-day regimen is a promising regimen.

the duration of concomitant therapy for the treatment of Helicobacter infection is not a major factor in determining treatment outcome.
